scenario_text: A dose-response study relates the probability of infection in exposed individuals to the ingested pathogen dose. Independent challenge experiments at varying doses yield an instantaneous infection probability. The mechanism is saturating dose-dependent infection risk. Host immune competence is held fixed across the experiment.
